findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: One of the soda nozzles and the coffee makers were observed soiled. The PIC was made aware. The PIC removed, cleaned and sanitized them respectively immediately. Ensure that food contact surfaces are monitored, cleaned, and sanitized at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a hole in the wall near the licenses behind the black curtain. Ensure repairs are made to make this surface smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 Inspection Report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice for this violation. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.114: There is an unused ice machine in the back storage area. This machine needs to be removed from the premises unless it is repaired in to working order. This is a repeat violation from the 3/27/2023 inspection report and the facility will receive a Warning Notice. 
6-501.114: The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The ceiling in the walk-in cooler is observed to be in a state of disrepair. Ensure the ceiling is repaired in a manner that makes it smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
2-102.12: This location is observed to only have 1 CFM on staff. In order to cover all hours of operation where food handling takes place, the facility needs to have more staff become Certified Food Managers. A CFM must be the person in charge and on duty during all hours of operation when food prep/cooking is taking place.
2-102.12: The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: The hand sink in the supply room is observed to not have any soap available. Ensure this sink is supplied with a supply of hand soap to allow for hand washing to take place. 
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: No hot water is available at the hand washing sink in the restroom or the hand washing sink right outside the restroom door in the customer area. Provide hot water of at least 100F at each of these hand washing sinks.
findings.citation_text: 5-202.12  (Pf) Provide water of at least 100 deg F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Reference 5-202.12.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: Parts for three compartment sink on order.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Open packages of roller grill items in the walk in cooler are not date marked with the date of opening. Large packages like the hot dogs and sausages are not used within 24 hours and therefore must be date marked with the date of opening (or alternatively the discard date) and held no longer than 7 days maximum.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Foods properly cooked and/or reheated
findings.comment:
Observed the chili and cheese sauces in the dispenser to be holding at internal temperatures of 111-112F respectively. The thermometer on the unit itself reflects this as well. Pull dispenser from use until unit can be repaired or replaced. Both of these items also had a discard date of 10/28 on them.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the ice flap in the ice machine to be soiled with a brown substance. 2) Observed the coffee maker spouts to be soiled black. Wash, rinse and sanitize these food contact surfaces.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
1) Observed the hand sink in the front customer service area to be a metered faucet that runs for only 1-2 seconds before shutting off. Faucet must run for an uninterrupted 15-20 seconds. 2) Observed the hand sink in the back near the three compartment sink to not have functioning hot water. Provide hot water at this faucet and again make sure it runs for an uninterrupted 15-20 seconds.
750-1120 Each lavatory shall be provided with hot and cold water tempered by means of a mixing valve or combination faucet.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the faucet at the three compartment sink to drip when off. Repair plumbing so faucet does not leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.comment:
Observed the mop stored in the back room with waste water and mop stored with it's head inside the bucket. Dispose of waste water immediately after use and store mop inverted to dry.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Walk in cooler's air temperature was 50F at start time of inspection. Multiple PHF were probed with a stem thermometer. Milk(49F), eggs(49F), cheese, bacon, lunchables, deli meats, and other PHF's were discarded during inspection. Hot dogs were probed and were 45F and below and moved to a different cooler. Do not store PHF in cooler until cooler holds at 41F or below. An order of destruction was filling out for food items that were discarded.
750-250  All potentially hazardous foods shall be kept at 41°F or below while on display and service.

Observed the bottom metal panel at the door of the walk in cooler to be bent. Reattach panel properly to the bottom of the door.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
No employee at facility currently holds their FSSMC. At least one employee at a medium risk facility should have a certified food managers certificate.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed top  of coffee spouts to be soiled with food debris. Manager CORRECTED violation by wash, rinsing, and sanitizing spout.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: There was no thermometer in the True freezer with the frozen pizzas.  Put a thermometer in the freezer.  It must be in a place where it can be easily read.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.comment:

2.  The top of the grease trap under the 3-pan sink was rusty.  Sand and paint the top of the grease trap.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
There were no disposable towels for the handsink to the right of the 3-pan sink.  Put disposable towels at the sink.

750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Outside storage area clean, enclosure properly constructed
findings.comment:
The dumpster was stored on gravel.  Put the dumpster a cleanable asphalt or concrete surface.  Note: the cardboard dumpster does not have to be on such a surface.

75-1140 Garbage and refuse containers shall be in good repair and stored on or above concrete or asphalt.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1.  The bottom inside of the drink counter is soiled and needs a new floor put in it that is smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)
2.  There are damaged floor tiles just inside the door of the walk-in cooler.  (REPEAT VIOLATION).  Replace the damaged tiles.
3.  The floor of the walk-in cooler is soiled in places under the shelves.  Clean the floor.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The strip of molding about 4 feet off the floor on the wall of the walk-in cooler is damaged and moldy in the back corner.  Repair/replace the molding.

750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
Floor cleaner and Goo Gone were stored on the shelf above the 3-pan sink.  They were set on the grease trap below the sink to CORRECT the violation.

750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
